name: UCI Women's WorldTour (women's road cycling)
notes: 14 UCI Women's WorldTeams granted 2026-2028 licences by the UCI Licence Commission (UCI press release, 2026-2028 cycle).
Every team is named after a sponsor; names change with sponsors.
Sponsor placement is mapped to the schema's front/back/sleeve/shorts/partner values from 'team title/name' and 'jersey'.
Mid-season rename: UAE Team ADQ became UAE Team L'IMAD on 1 August 2026 after ADQ was absorbed into L'IMAD; the UCI licence list still shows UAE Team ADQ (Cyclingnews, 2026-07-27).
